title: Flat finite-presentation lower truncation of a universally connective affine complex
statement: Let S be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Let C be a cochain complex of O_S-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] concentrated in [a,b], for a∈ℤ and b∈ℕ. Assume its terms are flat over S, quasi-coherent and finitely presented [def-pc-morphism-conventions]. Assume that for every scheme map g:S′→S the homology H^i(g*C) vanishes for all i<0 [def-pc-base-change]. The canonical lower truncation B=C.truncGE 0 (zero in degrees <0, coker(d^(-1)) in degree 0, C in positive degrees) has flat, quasi-coherent, finitely presented terms. For every g:S′→S and q∈ℕ there is an isomorphism H^q(g*B)≅H^q(g*C). No proper morphism or coefficient sheaf is part of this assertion.

proof.text: Apply affine_opcycles_flat_of_universally_exact using hneg at i=-1. Transfer flatness along truncGEXIsoOpcycles at zero. For negative degrees use the zero-object property of truncGE, and for positive degrees transfer the original flatness along truncGEXIso. This proves termwise flatness.

Identify the degree-zero term with cokernel(C.d (-1) 0) using truncGEXIsoOpcycles and opcyclesIsCokernel. Apply the source-library quasi-coherent cokernel closure and the ringed-space finite-presentation cokernel theorem, with hCqc and hCfp at -1 and 0. Transport both properties along the term isomorphism. Below zero use the free module on the empty family, and above zero use truncGEXIso and the original properties.

For arbitrary g:S′ -> S apply nonempty_map_truncGE_iso to Modules.pullback g, which is additive and left adjoint and thus preserves finite colimits. Map this complex isomorphism with homologyFunctor at q. Mathlib CochainComplex.quasiIsoAt_πTruncGE at n=0 and q>=0 makes the truncation projection of g*C an isomorphism on homology. Compose with its inverse to obtain H^q(g*truncGE C) ≅ H^q(g*C). This works also for q=0 and nonaffine S′.

mathlib_searches.query: A bounded complex of finite projective modules with no negative cohomology after every base change has a flat finitely presented degree zero cokernel
The degree zero cokernel of a bounded complex of finite projective modules is flat when all base changes have zero negative cohomology

mathlib_searches.results: Second reading: 12 results, including truncGEXIsoOpcycles, truncGEXIso and quasiIsoAt_πTruncGE; none supplies affine termwise flatness and finite presentation after arbitrary pullback.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_flat_connective_truncation (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : IsAffine S)
    (C : CochainComplex S.Modules ℤ) (a : ℤ) (b : ℕ)
    (hCge : C.IsStrictlyGE a) (hCle : C.IsStrictlyLE b)
    (hCflat : ∀ n : ℤ, (C.X n).IsFlatOver (𝟙 S))
    (hCqc : ∀ n : ℤ, (C.X n).IsQuasicoherent)
    (hCfp : ∀ n : ℤ, (C.X n).IsFinitePresentation)
    (hneg : ∀ {S' : Scheme.{u}} (g : S' ⟶ S) (i : ℤ), i < 0 →
      IsZero ((((Modules.pullback g).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj C).homology i)) :
    (∀ n : ℤ, ((C.truncGE 0).X n).IsFlatOver (𝟙 S)) ∧
    (∀ n : ℤ, ((C.truncGE 0).X n).IsQuasicoherent) ∧
    (∀ n : ℤ, ((C.truncGE 0).X n).IsFinitePresentation) ∧
    ∀ {S' : Scheme.{u}} (g : S' ⟶ S) (q : ℕ),
      Nonempty ((((Modules.pullback g).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj
          (C.truncGE 0)).homology q ≅
        (((Modules.pullback g).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj C).homology q)
